3.speaker: Lucita Azaro

15.speaker: Elena Werner

16.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

18.speaker: Lucita Azaro

25.speaker: Elena Werner
25.text: "Your reputation precedes you, Your Majesty. I've heard marvelous things about the work you did in Valenqiris."

26.speaker: Elena Werner
26.text: "I must say it makes me proud to see you in that seat. If you show the same devotion as you did on King Valero's council, you'll make a fine ruler."

27.speaker: Vina Toras
27.text: "I wouldn't go that far. But I do hope you'll tell me about your time in Queen Lyza's court one day."

33.speaker: Elena Werner
33.text: "I'm pleased to see the young heiress here as well. A new Lyza the Great in the making."

34.speaker: Elena Werner
34.text: "Yes, welcome, Your Majesty. If you're half the young man your father made you out to be, you'll make a fine king."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Thank you, Ms. Werner and Mr. Esquibel. I look forward to working with you."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "I don't need your approval, Ms. Werner. If anything, you're the one who should be seeking mine."

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "This formality doesn't suit any of us. Elena, Laurento, it's great to see you both again."

41.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
41.text: "Protocol is protocol, Your Majesty. Even if we've both known you since you were in diapers.'

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "I doubt my father ever praised me so highly. But thank you."

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "No need for flattery. With your years of experience, I'm the one who should be bowing down to you both."

44.speaker: Elena Werner
44.text: "Of-- of course. I misspoke. Forgive me."

46.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
46.text: "That's far too kind of you, Your Majesty. But I hope we old-timers can be of some assistance to you."

47.speaker: Elena Werner
47.text: "I'd love to. There are just a few updates I've got to share with your father first."

48.speaker: Narrator

49.speaker: Lucita Azaro

53.speaker: Lucita Azaro

57.speaker: Lucita Azaro
57.text: "My father always spoke highly of you, Your Majesty. I wish he was the one greeting you today."

59.speaker: Lucita Azaro
59.text: "Oh, excuse me. What brings you to these chambers, Your Highness?"

60.speaker: Narrator

61.speaker: Elena Werner
61.text: "For Dast's sake, Laurento, you don't need to hold the door open for me every single time. I'm not as fragile as I look."

62.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
62.text: "I keep telling you, how could I allow a door to close on such a gorgeous face?"

63.speaker: Narrator

67.speaker: Narrator

77.speaker: Narrator

78.speaker: Narrator
78.text: The day was sweltering, and the morning meeting had left me drained. I was glad I’d turned down Hugo’s offer of wine.

127.speaker: Narrator

128.speaker: Manus Sazon

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "I wish we could stay and talk, but the Princess and I must be going. Until next time."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Don't speak to him, Vina. We're going to be late."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "You are to stay away from me, Mr. Sazon. And even further away from my daughter."

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "I'm not uninterested in your proposition. But you'll have to request a formal audience with me like everyone else."

134.speaker: Manus Sazon
134.text: "I-- I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I won't trouble you again."

135.speaker: Manus Sazon
135.text: "I look forward to it, Your Majesty. Your Highness."

137.speaker: Manus Sazon

139.speaker: Manus Sazon
139.text: "That's perfectly fine. I hope to speak again when it's more convenient, Your Majesty. Your Highness."

142.speaker: Vina Toras
142.text: "He was only trying to be nice."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "Nice, my foot. That man has all kinds of ulterior motives."

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "I mean it, Vina. I don't want you talking to him."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "He shouldn't be cornering the King of Rizia on his way to an important meeting. The kid needs to learn decorum."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "Don't get too smitten. He's the opposition, after all."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "He's friendlier than I expected. I could imagine working together."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "I wish I could stay and talk, but I must be going. Until next time."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "I'm not interested. If you'll excuse me, I'm going to be late."

152.speaker: Player_Romus

153.speaker: Player_Romus

174.speaker: Lucita Azaro
174.text: "I'm sorry I couldn't make it to the coronation. I heard everything ran smoothly."

175.speaker: Lucita Azaro
175.text: "General Taddeus sends his regards. Or he would if he were capable of speaking in full sentences."

178.speaker: Player_Romus

179.speaker: Narrator
179.text: She was trying to be flippant, but I could sense emotion behind her words.

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "This must be a difficult time for you. Let me know if there's anything I can do."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "No time for pleasantries. Where are the others?"

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "I hope he heals swiftly. I was counting on his expertise as a councilor."

185.speaker: Lucita Azaro
185.text: "Two of them were right behind me on the stairs."

186.speaker: Lucita Azaro
186.text: "The others should be right behind me."

187.speaker: Lucita Azaro
187.text: "I'll do my best to serve in his stead."

188.text: The corners of her mouth twitched downward.

189.speaker: Lucita Azaro

211.text: "Well -- not the entire council. The Grand Wiseman is in Plavo, preparing for the upcoming religious ceremony with His Majesty."

212.speaker: Hugo Toras
212.text: "But he needn't involve himself in earthly concerns like our royal treasury."

213.speaker: Narrator

214.speaker: Elena Werner

215.speaker: Elena Werner

218.speaker: Elena Werner
218.text: "Frankly, I'm glad to see you taking such an interest in our financials."

219.speaker: Elena Werner
219.text: "Between myself and the House of Delegates, we were able to keep everything running smoothly in the absence of clear guidance from your father."

220.speaker: Elena Werner
220.text: "But with a king of your caliber at the helm, there's no telling how high we can soar."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "History shall know me as Romus the Fiscally Responsible."

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "Your hard work during my father's decline is to be commended."

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Please leave my father out of this. I'd prefer to be judged on my own merits, not compared to him."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "Do not speak ill of His Majesty. He did the best he could in the face of his many enemies."

226.speaker: Elena Werner
226.text: "Thank you. It was indeed quite the stressful time for everyone."

230.speaker: Elena Werner
230.text: "That is undoubtedly true, Your Majesty. I'm sorry."

232.speaker: Elena Werner
232.text: "I think that's enough for today. But we will have to come to a decision regarding our resources."

233.speaker: Elena Werner
233.text: "Gold and energy exports have gotten us to where we are today, but if we are to stay relevant and protect our economy from global fluctuations, we need to diversify. I suspect you agree."

234.speaker: Elena Werner
234.text: "I'll let you think about it, Your Majesty."

235.speaker: Hugo Toras
235.text: "Thank you, Ms. Werner. This was indeed enlightening."

236.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
236.text: "A pleasure to share these chambers with you once more, King Romus."

240.speaker: Laurento Esquibel

241.speaker: Lucita Azaro

246.speaker: Lucita Azaro

252.speaker: Player_Romus

253.speaker: Narrator

257.speaker: Elena Werner
257.text: "Secondly, there's the matter of living standards. Improving the quality of life for our citizens naturally leads to higher administrative expenditures."

258.speaker: Elena Werner
258.text: "Thirdly, if you do decide to listen to Duchess Azaro and expand our defense capabilities, keep in mind that the cost of upkeep for our armed forces will rise accordingly."

259.speaker: Elena Werner
259.text: "Lastly, energy management poses its own challenges. As we approach the limits of our grid's capacity, we may incur additional storage costs."

260.speaker: Elena Werner
260.text: "The first point to consider is industrial growth. I am all for expanding production and construction, but we should make sure we have the energy to keep our facilities humming."

261.speaker: Elena Werner
261.text: "I'd like to discuss several economic considerations. We should anticipate potential expenses arising from our impending fiscal policies."

262.speaker: Narrator
262.text: Elena glanced down at her notes, her expression contemplative.

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "This information is invaluable, Elena. I appreciate your insights."

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "That'll be a long way off in the future. I have more pressing worries at the moment."

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "I have full confidence in your ability to handle these matters."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "That's very good to know. I'll make my decisions accordingly."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "We've covered enough ground for today. Let's adjourn the meeting soon."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "I'm accustomed to handling unexpected challenges. A detailed explanation isn't necessary."

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "She's here to learn from the King, as I learned from my father."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "She's here to receive tutelage from the best minds this kingdom has to offer. Yours included."

279.speaker: Elena Werner
279.text: "Very well. It seems like you've got a good grasp on our financials."

283.text: "Thank you anyway, Ms. Werner. I'll be sure to deliver your reports to His Majesty."

292.speaker: Elena Werner
292.text: "While gold and energy exports remain the backbone of our economy, supplementing them with other industries will make us more robust and less vulnerable to global fluctuations. I suspect you agree."

293.speaker: Elena Werner
